CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit




Private Sub Command55_Click()

Dim RC As Recordset: Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("CFGs")
Dim ctl As Control

For Each ctl In Me.Controls
    If ctl.Properties(2) = 109 Or ctl.Properties(2) = 106 Then
        RC.FindFirst "CFG='" & ctl.Name & "'"
        If Not RC.NoMatch Then
            RC.Edit
                RC!Vl = ctl.value
            RC.Update
        End If
    End If
Next

RC.FindFirst "CFG='Password'"
RC.Edit
    RC!Vl = PSW(Nz(Password, ""), False)
RC.Update

Set RC = Nothing

MsgBox "Salvare efectuata!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
End Sub


Private Sub Command76_MouseDown(Button As Integer, Shift As Integer, x As Single, y As Single)
Me.Password.InputMask = ""
End Sub


Private Sub Command76_MouseUp(Button As Integer, Shift As Integer, x As Single, y As Single)
Me.Password.InputMask = "Password"
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Load()

Dim RC As Recordset

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM CFGs WHERE F='FA'", dbOpenDynaset)
POP RC
Do While Not RC.EOF
    If RC!CFG = "Password" Then
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = PSW(RC!Vl, True)
    Else
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = RC!Vl
    End If
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM CFGs WHERE F='FD'", dbOpenDynaset)
POP RC
Do While Not RC.EOF
    If RC!CFG = "Password" Then
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = PSW(RC!Vl, True)
    Else
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = RC!Vl
    End If
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM CFGs WHERE F='FC'", dbOpenDynaset)
POP RC
Do While Not RC.EOF
    If RC!CFG = "Password" Then
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = PSW(RC!Vl, True)
    Else
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = RC!Vl
    End If
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM CFGs WHERE F='FF'", dbOpenDynaset)
POP RC
Do While Not RC.EOF
    If RC!CFG = "Password" Then
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = PSW(RC!Vl, True)
    Else
        Me.Controls("" & RC!CFG & "").value = RC!Vl
    End If
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

RC.Close

IESIRE.SetFocus

If DLookup("VL", "CFGs", "CFG='Platitor'") = "Buget" Then
    P1.visible = False
    P2.visible = False
    P4.visible = False
Else
    P1.visible = True
    P2.visible = True
    P4.visible = True
End If

Set RC = Nothing

Body_FA.Enabled = Not Trimite_Doc

Hlp1.visible = False
lHlp.visible = False
End Sub


Private Sub IESIRE_Click()
DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.Name

End Sub

Private Sub Trimite_Doc_Click()
Body_FA.Enabled = Not Trimite_Doc
End Sub

Private Sub Zile_AfterUpdate()
If Nz(Zile, "") = "" Then Zile = 1
If Zile > 30 Then
    MsgBox "Mesajele pot fi afisate cu maximum 30 de zile inaintea expirarii!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Zile = 30
End If
If Zile = 0 Then MsgBox "Atentie! 0 (zero) zile inseamna ca nu se va afisa niciun mesaj despre fisele care sunt pe punctul de a expira!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
End Sub

Private Sub HTML_Click()
If HTML Then
    Body_FA.TextFormat = acTextFormatHTMLRichText
    Body_FD.TextFormat = acTextFormatHTMLRichText
    Body_FC.TextFormat = acTextFormatHTMLRichText
Else
    Body_FA.TextFormat = acTextFormatPlain
    Body_FD.TextFormat = acTextFormatPlain
    Body_FC.TextFormat = acTextFormatHTMLRichText
End If
End Sub

Private Sub Interval_AfterUpdate()
If Nz(Interval, "") = "" Then Interval = 0
If Interval > 10 Then
    MsgBox "Numarul maxim de secunde este 10!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Interval = 10
End If
End Sub
